headline: Friday Shopping: Several Dhaka markets closed today
summary: Check the list of closed markets and museums in the capital to avoid unnecessary trips this Friday.
details: Several major markets and shopping centers across Dhaka remain closed every Friday. This includes Azimpur Super Market, Gulistan Hawkers Market, and the Farashganj Timber Market.
Other closed locations include the wholesale shops of Shyambazar, Samad Super Market, Rahmania Super Market, and Idris Super Market.
Shopping hubs like Chawkbazar, Babu Bazar, Naya Bazar, Kaptan Bazar, and the Rajdhani Super Market are also closed today.
The list extends to the Dayaganj City Corporation Market, Islampur clothing stores, Choto Katra, Boro Katra wholesale market, Sharif Mansion, and Phulbaria Market.
Additionally, the Military Museum at Bijoy Sarani is closed every Thursday and Friday.
The National Museum of Science and Technology in Agargaon is also closed on Thursdays and Fridays.
The Children's Academy Museum near Doel Chattar is closed every Friday and Saturday.
caption:
Planning a shopping trip in Dhaka today? Check which markets are closed before you head out.

Several major markets and shopping centers across Dhaka remain closed every Friday. This includes Azimpur Super Market, Gulistan Hawkers Market, and the Farashganj Timber Market.

Other closed locations include the wholesale shops of Shyambazar, Samad Super Market, Rahmania Super Market, and Idris Super Market.

Shopping hubs like Chawkbazar, Babu Bazar, Naya Bazar, Kaptan Bazar, and the Rajdhani Super Market are also closed today.

The list extends to the Dayaganj City Corporation Market, Islampur clothing stores, Choto Katra, Boro Katra wholesale market, Sharif Mansion, and Phulbaria Market.

Additionally, the Military Museum at Bijoy Sarani is closed every Thursday and Friday.

The National Museum of Science and Technology in Agargaon is also closed on Thursdays and Fridays.

The Children's Academy Museum near Doel Chattar is closed every Friday and Saturday.

headline: Water release decided for Kaptai Dam
summary: Authorities have decided to release water from the Kaptai Dam to manage water levels.
details: Authorities have taken the decision to release water from the Kaptai Dam. This measure is typically implemented to maintain safe water levels within the reservoir.
The decision comes as part of routine water management to prevent overflow and ensure the structural integrity of the dam.
Local residents and downstream areas are likely to be notified of the water release to prepare for potential rises in water levels.
